items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He’s French I believe. ... [INTERVIEWEE] It doesn’t matter that much, they’re both great.

ctx.x: Well maybe he is, but I’ll tell you, he acts like a Frenchman though. Boy we’ll have to check that out.
It doesn’t matter that much, they’re both great.
